audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagreed with the already-audited Sylas side, which realigned the chart to Vayne, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Vayne in both layers.
audit.why: Level 1 is one spell each and Chain Lash is his only reach, so it is Vayne's. From 2 onward Kingslayer heals off her every 12s at rank 1 and Abscond/Abduct closes on 13s, which is more than three autos beat. Two items of Silver Bolts is where it turns back.
audit.corrected: Vayne, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Vayne — matched full/content pairs with ratings rescaled.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was described generically as 'a strong ult' and never named Hijack or gave its cooldown; first item was called Vayne's spike.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30s — the shortest ultimate cooldown in the matchup — and against Vayne it steals Final Hour itself, so he gets her spike as well as his own. Blade of the Ruined King does not out-race Kingslayer's heal on its own; two items does.
audit.corrected: His 6 is Hijack on 80s and it takes your own ultimate; your spike is two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two lines instruct the player to 'Condemn him mid-dash' to cancel Abscond/Abduct. Nothing in the kit supports cancelling a dash with a knockback, and spending a 20s Condemn on that is how the trade is lost. Not one Sylas ability was ever named.
audit.why: Condemn is a 550-range knockback on 20s at rank 1; its verified payoff is the terrain stun. Abscond dashes and recasts as Abduct to pull him in — the right use is after he has arrived, to put distance back. Kingslayer heals him against champions, so Grievous Wounds timing, not extra damage, decides the long trade.
audit.corrected: Bait Abscond, then Condemn him away once he lands; buy anti-heal against Kingslayer.

edits.before: Kite with autos and never let him touch you. Identify how Sylas contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One spell each at level 1 and Chain Lash is his only reach — step up, auto him, step back out. The stage is yours.

edits.before: Q tumble resets make your spacing untouchable. Only take the trade when Sylas's Abscond / Abduct is down.
edits.after: Kingslayer heals him off you every 12s at rank 1, so short trades feed him. Buy Grievous Wounds before you commit.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Sylas must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His chain is online: Chain Lash slows, Abduct pulls, Kingslayer heals it back. Three autos do not beat that yet.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Abscond / Abduct's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Abscond dashes and recasts as Abduct to pull him onto you on 13s at rank 1 — hold Condemn for that, not for chip damage.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sylas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Hijack steals your Final Hour and hands him your own ultimate — do not fight at 6 until that stolen ult has been spent.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Abscond / Abduct's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King lands, but Kingslayer still heals through it. Fight only once his W is spent.

edits.before: At 2 you still out-trade before his mana supports spam.
edits.after: At 2 Chain Lash slows you into his Kingslayer heal.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you before his full Q-E-W is online.
edits.after: At 3 the full Q-E-W chain out-trades three autos.

edits.before: The 4-5 window is a skill coin-flip on his E-chain flips.
edits.after: Through 4-5 Abduct pulls him onto you on a 13s cooldown.

edits.before: First-item true damage swings it back your way.
edits.after: First item Kingslayer's heal still out-lasts you.

edits.before: Early you out-trade Sylas with Q-auto poke before his Q-E-W combo comes online; the level 4-5 window is a coin-flip because his E dash-chain plus W heal can flip a trade if he lands the second Q hit — so bait his E and Condemn him mid-dash.
edits.after: Early you out-trade Sylas with Q-auto poke before his chain is online; from 3 the Q-E-W rotation plus Kingslayer's heal flips every trade, so bait Abscond and Condemn him away once he lands. Anti-heal matters here more than extra damage.

edits.before: Sylas spikes hard at 6 because he steals your Final Hour or a strong enemy ult — this is his window, so play safe, hold Condemn for his E gap-close, and don't fight until his stolen ult is used.
edits.after: Sylas spikes at 6: Hijack steals your Final Hour outright and comes back every 80s at rank 1. Play safe, hold Condemn for Abduct, and take no fight until that stolen ultimate has been spent.

edits.before: Condemn to cancel his E dash-chain
edits.after: Condemn him off you after Abduct

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Petricite Burst turns each of his autos into free area damage.
